_comment: Instructions whose immediate is a runtime variable the port sets (tools/recomp: the encoded value is checked, then the C code reads the variable). dcb_card_limit: 301 + the new cards (src/game/cards/cards.cpp); loops that only flag or count each card's own byte run over the new ones too.

immediates.why: 8004844C: clears flag 0x80 of each card's collection byte
game_data_init: clears each card's collection byte (a new game)
Card Menu / Deck Edit sort: the number of table entries sorted (the comparators read records and per-card bytes only)
Deck Edit init: the available copies per card (801F7BF0, allocated 304 bytes)
Card Menu 'complete' mark: every card seen
Card Menu 'complete' mark: the copies total
